snippet.title: Songs of Silence - Lighteaters DLC Trailer | Art Nouveau-inspired Fantasy Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Ancient beings lurking in the Silence, the Lighteaters are neither truly alive nor dead—forever cursed to feast on the Hymn. Will you wield their arcane power or fall to their insatiable hunger?

🟠 Steam — https://bit.ly/SOS-Lighteaters-Steam
🟣 GOG — https://bit.ly/SOS-Lighteaters-GOG

🔥 Lighteaters DLC – What’s Inside? 🔥
✔️ New Faction: The Lighteaters, masters of life-draining and healing 
✔️ 2 Hero Archetypes & 6 Hero Vocations to command the battlefield
✔️ 8 New Units including the relentless Mawling and the fearsome Shrieker
✔️ 5 New Strategy Abilities like Nexus Recall & Devour Light
✔️ 8 New Battle Abilities to shift the tides of war
✔️ 1 New Capital – Nexus, the dark heart of the Lighteaters' power

💀 Shape Fate, Drain the Hymn, Dominate Skirmish Battles!
Play as the Lighteaters or fight against them in single-player and multiplayer skirmishes—even if you don’t own the DLC!

📜 Official Website — https://bit.ly/Songs_of_Silence_website
📰 Press Kit – https://impress.games/press-kit/rcp/songs-of-silence

#SongsOfSilence #ArtNouveau #4X #TurnBasedStrategy #IndieGame
